name: Dead Canary

features.name: xBomb cross blasts
features.description: Clear a cross pattern and raise the multiplier.

review:
Dead Canary is a mining slot with an uneven 3-4-3-4-3-4 grid and barriers that block parts of the reels. If three to five matching symbols line up diagonally without a win, Wild Mining is triggered, and scatters that land behind a barrier don't count until it's cleared.

xBomb Wilds explode in a cross pattern around themselves, clearing symbols and boosting the multiplier. The bonus is Canary Freespins. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 65,000x ceiling.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
